claims.claim_text: Section 1 identifies RA 9266 as the Architecture Act of 2004 and states that it repealed RA 545 as amended.
Section 2 states the policy frame for regulation, registration, licensure, practice, and architecture education.
Section 3 defines architecture, Architect, Architect-of-Record, Architect-in-Charge of Construction, Consulting Architect, scope of practice, and structural conceptualization.
Section 4 creates the PRBoA under PRC supervision and administrative control and uses IAPOA nominees for Board appointments.
Section 6 gives a three-year Board term and one full-term reappointment rule.
